## 🔍 Dashboard Analysis

The Power BI dashboard provides interactive analysis across multiple dimensions of the chocolate sales dataset.

### 📌 Key Performance Indicators

* 💰 **Total Sales Amount**
* 📦 **Total Boxes Sold**

### 📈 Sales Trend Analysis

* Year-wise sales
* Quarter-wise sales
* Month-wise sales
* Date-range filtering

### 🌎 Geographic Analysis

* Country-wise sales performance
* Comparison of sales across countries

### 👥 Sales Performance

* Sales-person-wise performance
* Comparison of sales generated by individual sales representatives

### 🍫 Product Analysis

* Product-wise sales performance
* Identification of higher-performing products

### 🎛️ Interactive Filtering

The dashboard includes a **date slicer** that allows users to analyze sales for a selected time period.

## 💡 Business Value

This dashboard helps users:

* Monitor overall sales performance
* Identify high-performing products
* Compare country-level performance
* Evaluate sales-person performance
* Analyze sales trends over time
* Use KPIs to support data-driven decisions
